documents_list_filtered_note: These numbers describe the filtered list.
documents_empty_body: Contracts, runbooks, price sheets. The things you send people often enough to stop hunting for. Share each one with the people or the team who need it; an unshared upload is visible only to you and to admins.
documents_new_sub: Add a file, then choose who can open it. Nobody sees it until you share it.
documents_new_error_title: Give the document a title you would recognise in a list.
documents_new_title_hint: What you would call it out loud. It has to be unique here.
documents_new_file_hint: PDFs, sheets, docs. Whatever you send people often.
documents_new_unshared: Only you and admins, until you share it.

match.countPlural=one: Reaches {shown} person or team, plus admins.
match.countPlural=other: Reaches {shown} people and teams, plus admins.

documents_new_nobody_to_share: No teammates or teams to share with yet. The document will be visible to you and admins.
documents_error_upload_forbidden: You do not have permission to upload here.
documents_edit_locked_text: Changing a document is limited to the person who uploaded it and admins. You can open a document shared with you, but not edit it.
documents_edit_file_hint: Leave this empty to keep the current file. Choosing one replaces it, and the title and shares stay as they are.
documents_edit_status_inactive: Archived, kept, hidden from the default view
documents_edit_options_failed: The people and teams list did not load, so sharing cannot be changed right now. Saving keeps everyone this document is shared with.

match.countPlural=one: Also shared with one person no longer active. Saving keeps that share.
match.countPlural=other: Also shared with {countShown} people no longer active. Saving keeps those shares.

documents_edit_delete_hint: Archiving keeps the document and its history; delete removes it for everyone who could open it. Delete only when it was uploaded by mistake.
documents_error_not_found: That document does not exist, or it belongs to another org.
documents_error_edit_forbidden: Only the owner or an admin can change this document.
documents_error_delete_forbidden: Only the owner or an admin can delete this document.
